## ApiResponseExtensions

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Ui.Services.ApiResponseExtensions</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Ui.Services/Services/ApiResponseExtensions.cs:12](../../../../src/Meridian.Ui.Services/Services/ApiResponseExtensions.cs#L12).

Bridging helpers for callers migrating off the legacy null-returning ApiClientService.GetAsync{T}/ApiClientService.PostAsync{T} seam (audit finding P7). DataOrLoggedNull{T} unwraps an ApiResponse{T} to the legacy nullable result while keeping the legacy path&#x27;s diagnostics: non-404 failures are logged with the operation context before null is returned. Call sites converted with this helper are transport-migrated and ratchet-clean; their public contracts move to ApiResponse{T} end-to-end in the follow-on consumer batches.
